_comment: RELEASE BRANCH deep key-parity baseline: per-locale (missing|extra) leaf-key counts vs `en` (source of truth). On this branch `en`/`es` carry the ~116 El-Salvador agriculture keys (charts.*, pestAlerts.*, chatbot.*, etc.) added in cf657a6ec; the other 12 locales (restored from main) intentionally do NOT — El Salvador serves only en/es via VUE_APP_AVAILABLE_LOCALES, so the gap is invisible to users. Backfilling English-fallback into the 12 is deferred (a translation pass is the proper follow-up). localeConsistency.test.js fails only when a locale's counts GROW beyond this baseline (new divergence). When the agri keys are translated/backfilled, shrink these numbers to lock the improvement. Do NOT increase them to silence a regression.
